summary: Softmax's Korean RPG series, spanning the Korea-only Windows original, a PS2/PSP sequel, and an Xbox 360 follow-up.

entries.title: Magna Carta: The Phantom of Avalanche

emulation.notes: Use lawful original media/files and compatibility testing.

primary.why: The Phantom of Avalanche was released only for Windows in Korea and has no documented modern port, so the original PC release is the only authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a lawful original Korean Windows copy on compatible hardware or a preservation VM. Expect Korean text and old-PC compatibility work.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake/remaster or official English release is documented.

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test timing/FMVs before a full run.

primary.why: The PS2 release is the original high-fidelity console version, while the PSP release is a portable adaptation; PCSX2 is the best capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with upscaling and tested timing settings. PSP is useful only for portable comparison.

entries.title: MagnaCarta 2

emulation.notes: Original Xbox 360 hardware is the conservative route unless emulation compatibility is verified.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox 360 output or experimental Xbox 360 emulation.

primary.why: MagnaCarta 2 was released exclusively for Xbox 360 and no modern port or official backward-compatible route is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox 360 hardware with an owned disc. Xenia can be tested privately only if compatibility is acceptable and a legal disc dump is available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster or port is documented.
